economy.summary: Prokopiak said he is advocating for a $15 minimum wage and focuses on working-class families struggling with the cost of putting a roof over their heads, education, and health care.
economy.short: Advocates a $15 minimum wage; focuses on working-class cost of living

abortion.summary: Prokopiak said he supports codifying abortion rights and describes his agenda as pro-worker, pro-family, and pro-women's rights.

education.summary: Prokopiak said he supports increasing state education funding, noting that the absence of state money has overburdened local taxpayers.

healthcare.summary: Prokopiak said ensuring working-class families have affordable health care is among his priorities.
healthcare.short: Says affordable health care for families is a priority

energy.summary: In his Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania endorsement profile, Prokopiak stated priorities including combating climate change, reducing pollution, increasing use of renewable energy technology, and promoting electric vehicle ownership.
energy.short: Prioritizes combating climate change, renewable energy, and electric vehicles
